title: Niçoise Salad with Tuna & Soft-Boiled Eggs
description: Removing traditional boiled potatoes eliminates the primary glycemic spike of classical French Niçoise. Extra virgin olive oil provides oleocanthal and polyphenols that protect LDL particles against oxidation.
diabeticNotes: Removing traditional boiled potatoes eliminates the primary glycemic spike of classical French Niçoise. Extra virgin olive oil provides oleocanthal and polyphenols that protect LDL particles against oxidation.

ingredients.name: solid light tuna in spring water or olive oil, drained
large egg (boiled 6.5 minutes for a jammy soft center, halved)
tender haricots verts / green beans, trimmed
mixed artisan salad greens / butter lettuce

steps.title: Blanch Green Beans
steps.description: Blanch green beans in boiling salted water for 3 minutes until crisp-tender. Transfer immediately to ice water to shock and lock in bright green color. Drain well.

steps.title: Whisk Vinaigrette
steps.description: Whisk olive oil, red wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small bowl.

steps.title: Base Greens
steps.description: Arrange mixed greens in a wide salad bowl.

steps.title: Assemble Salad
steps.description: Artfully place flaked tuna, soft-boiled egg halves, blanched green beans, cherry tomatoes, and Kalamata olives over the greens.

steps.title: Dress & Serve
steps.description: Drizzle vinaigrette evenly over the salad right before serving.
